tooling.message:
fix: guidance and checks from the first creator run

## Intent

The first full run showed where an assistant gets stuck: it could not report or pick up a template bug, a pushed work branch became the default, Pages was off, its own link checks hit rate limits, a failing template test gave no hint, and plan-only commits redeployed the app.

## Key changes

- The skills say that a runtime test failing on valid content is a template bug: tell the creator, open an issue on app-templates, never work around it.
- `lernapps update` moves an app to the runtime, tooling and actions the current tooling pins, and reports what moved.
- The plan template and AGENTS.md use a work branch `work`; main comes with the first publish. Clicks the creator must make go into the publish question; plan edits after publishing are pushed once.
- App publish warns, with the clicks, when the default branch is not main.
- The link checks retry HTTP 429 briefly, then report the link as not checked at severity hint.
- checks-pass names a failing generic test of the template as a template test, with where to report it.
- A push that changes only the plan publishes nothing.
- The plan template and the listing skill say the results comment reads "bestanden" on a pass.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The catalog writes the passing comment (37fdfa5 in apps).

fix(listing): a passing check also creates the results comment

## Intent

The listing comment was created only for a failing check. On a first listing that passed, the creator's assistant found no comment to read and had to guess from the check runs.

## Key changes

- Every check that checked an entry creates the one comment or updates it in place.
- The passing comment is short: "Prüfung des Eintrags: bestanden", the checked address and time, the measured values and the number of rules.
- llms.txt says the comment appears on every run.
- Tests cover the passing comment and the workflow step with a stand-in for GitHub's CLI.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling's guidance names this comment (e427ce9).
